title: Four launch doors and a Decide later choice in onboarding
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-22: scrub the niche pages that are not part of the four-niche launch and tie the funnel into the onboarding choices with a Decide later option. The community-builders and teachers /for doors are retired and redirect to event-hosts and coaches-and-healers (ADR-1863); sign-up and Create a Space gain a Decide later choice. No new admin surfaces.
